description: Suggest the top 3 video templates for the caller's intent. Filters by feature requirements (voiceover/avatar) and budget; returns templates ranked by suitability with token cost, supported features, and a one-line rationale. Use this before create_video when the agent needs to pick a template — far better than guessing from list_templates.

hasAvatar.description: Require an AI avatar. Set false for voiceover-only or pure visual templates.

hasVoiceover.description: Require a voiceover. Set false to filter to silent visual templates.

intent.description: What the user wants — e.g. 'product launch ad for skincare', 'fast Reels short with text overlays', 'CEO talking-head pitch'.

maxTokens.description: Cap on token cost. Templates more expensive than this are filtered out.

targetDurationSec.description: Target final video length in seconds. Templates whose duration window does not include this value are excluded.

name: recommend_template
